column3: With respect to the 512 West 22nd Street Mortgage Loan (9.4%), (a) Genius Sports Media Inc., the second largest tenant, is in a free rent period until January 12, 2026, and (b) Kenneth Cole Productions Inc., the third largest tenant, is in a free rent period until April 1, 2026. The borrower was required at loan origination to deposit $1,689,925.47 in connection with the foregoing.
